title: Move ClaimDesk authorization from LDAP groups to JWT claims with identical behaviour
scenario: ClaimDesk authorizes every request from corporate LDAP groups, including nested ones. The agent portal will call it with Okta access tokens instead, and the business signed off on one condition: nobody's access changes on cutover day. Prove it with an embedded LDAP server and a local token issuer.
task: Implement JwtRoleResolver: RS256-only validation against a JWKS, iss, aud, exp and nbf with 60 s skew
Map the Okta groups claim to the existing roles so ClaimPolicy decides identically
Find and close the semantic gaps between LDAP groups and the token
Write the parity argument and the cutover and rollback plan
acceptance: Hidden parity matrix: every user x action x boundary amount identical via LDAP and JWT
Rejects wrong aud and iss, expiry beyond skew, foreign keys, alg none and HS256 confusion
Missing or unknown groups deny without errors; two-key JWKS works
ANSWER.md explains each gap and the rollout
